title: The two-torsion subtype has four elements
statement: Let k be an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero with decidable equality, and let W be a Weierstrass curve over k with W.Δ ≠ 0. Then Nat.card {P : W.toAffine.Point // (2 : ℕ) • P = 0} = 4, including the identity among these four points.
lean_statement: ∀ (k : Type) [Field k] [CharZero k] [IsAlgClosed k] [DecidableEq k] (W : WeierstrassCurve k), W.Δ ≠ 0 → Nat.card {P : W.toAffine.Point // (2 : ℕ) • P = 0} = 4
